assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a full-bleed 16:9 landscape illustration, 1536x864 or similar wide ratio, as the contextual background for a beautiful Year 6 science presentation. One continuous coastal landscape extends to every edge. Main subject: a sheltered sandy beach curves around to a rocky tidepool in the lower-right third, small rounded sea-worn rocks, turquoise water and a distant lavender headland. Camera: wide shore-level view. Keep the LEFT 65% and TOP 55% exceptionally calm pale aqua sky with only a subtle atmospheric wash; shoreline and main rocks live in bottom third and far right. Style: refined flat 2D editorial illustration, clean gently rounded contours, generous simple shapes, delicate restrained paper texture, soft atmospheric layers, like a beautifully art-directed children's science book. Palette: warm ivory sand #F5E8CF, sea-glass teal #298F91, pale aqua #E7F4F3, ink navy #183F4A, muted coral #D97961 and lavender #A5A4C8. A few thin curved water edges but no busy repetitive line pattern. Inviting and curious, no people, no faces. No text, letters, numbers, charts, arrows, icons, logos, diagram, borders or graphic panels. Not a slide layout, no 3D, no photorealism. Environment fills the canvas.
